title: BanditBox layout document
description: Everything a profile shows on the TV. One per profile, plus optional per-device overrides. The web UI, backups, theme sharing and imports all read and write this format.

schema.description: Format version. Breaking changes bump this.

profileId.description: Stable profile id, for example p_kids.

version.description: Increases with every change the server accepts.

itemRef.description: An app package name, or folder:<id>.

mediaRef.description: Content-addressed media on the server: media:sha256-<hex>.

packWallpaperRef.description: A built-in wallpaper, pack:<pack>/<wallpaper>, as listed in themes.json.

pin.description: Hash of the PIN, never the PIN itself. Null means no lock.

autoLogin.description: Open this profile at boot without the picker.

kids.description: Present only on a kids profile. The TV shows approved apps only, enforces the limits below, draws a kids-safe theme, and asks for parentPin before settings, switching profiles or lifting a lock.

parentPin.description: Hash of the parent PIN, same format as profile.pin. Null leaves the parent options open.

approvedApps.description: The only apps this profile can see or open.

dailyLimitMin.description: Minutes of app time a day, counted from midnight on the TV. Null means no limit.

warnMin.description: Minutes of warning before the limit or bedtime. 0 turns the warning off.

bedtime.description: Lock window, local to the TV. An end earlier than start runs past midnight.

unlockMin.description: How long the parent PIN lifts a bedtime or time-up lock.

theme.description: How the profile looks. Every field is optional: a missing one takes the preset's value. themes.json lists the presets and wallpaper packs.

id.description: A preset from themes.json (nuclear, laser, dark, kids-dark, neon, cinematic, futuristic, or a variant such as neon-tokyo), or a custom theme's id. An unknown id draws the default preset with the fields below on top.

adaptiveAccent.description: Take the accent from the wallpaper's colors. accent, or the preset's accent, is the fallback when the wallpaper has no strong color.

wallpaper.description: An uploaded picture (media:sha256-<hex>), a pack wallpaper (pack:<pack>/<wallpaper>), or none for the plain background. Null or missing uses the preset's wallpaper.

wallpaperDim.description: How much to darken the wallpaper so tiles stay readable; 0 is none. Null picks 0 for pack wallpapers and 0.45 for pictures.

iconPack.description: system draws each app's own icon. banditbox-uniform puts every icon on the same plate in the theme's colors; banditbox-mono also tints it with the accent. pkg:<package> uses an installed icon pack app (ADW/Nova format). Applies to icon tiles and to apps without a TV banner.

type.description: system leaves it to Android. The oled- types are drawn by the launcher on black with nothing held in place: oled-drift moves a dim clock every minute, oled-starfield is a slow star field, oled-black is plain black.

timeoutMin.description: Minutes without a button press on the launcher before the screensaver starts.

themeColors.description: Overrides for the preset's colors, for custom themes made in the web UI.

oneOf.description: Continue watching: the Android TV Watch Next list that apps such as Plex, YouTube and Jellyfin publish.

kinds.description: Which entries to show: continue (started), next (next episode), new (new episode or season), watchlist (saved for later).

apps.description: Only entries from these apps. Null or missing means every app.

oneOf.description: One app's preview channel: a row the app publishes for the Android TV home screen.

channel.description: The channel's name as the app publishes it, or its internal provider id. Null or missing means the app's first channel.

contentLimit.description: The most cards a content row shows.

contentSize.description: Card height on a content row.

topBarItem.description: A built-in item (clock, inputs, network, settings, profile) or a widget feed id.

key.description: Key name without the KEYCODE_ prefix, for example HOME or PROG_RED.
